g.text: Queries with ≥1 judged specialist in each group
Cycle 02 | TREC Deep Learning 2019–2020 | Frozen full-list observation inventory
A Specialist candidates by owner and support
B Beyond the retained lexical rankings
SPLADE++ top10 against the original lexical full-list union
Judged means a recorded assessment exists, including grade 0. Judgment availability does not establish relevance.
Specialist: source top10 and absent from every other source’s top30. Tail supported: rank >30 in another full list.
Full lists: four supplied lexical sources plus SPLADE++ top1000. All groups are fixed from these original lists.
Counts are query-document observations, not independent samples. Paired-query counts alone do not establish adequate precision.
